notes.title: Release Candidate ver 20170606_006
notes.notes:
While we write this text.. the game is getting out from the oven!!!
We deleted all the leaderboards (sorry betatesters), now is up to you to be the first in all the levels!
We are very happy to share with you [b]xoEl Empire[/b]!.
 
[h1]FIXED BUGS [/h1]
[list]
[*][strike][b]issue 065[/b]
Some camera clips and oclussion glitches, in places we are not going to tell you...[/strike]
[*][strike][b]issue 051[/b]
When you fall with a partner attached, collision with partner can make you float[/strike]
[*][strike][b]issue 006 [/b]
Ship corridors need more ambience sounds.[/strike]
[*][strike][b]issue 042[/b]
Steam avatars appear flipped by width,[i]()[/i][/strike]
[*][strike][b]issue 050[/b]
in main menu when selecting the max stick sensibility with xbox controllers the player moves continuously[/strike]
[*][strike][b]issue 066[/b]
In Linux the mouse pointer is hidden somewhere,[i]A xoElian Dev says that he is sure the mouse pointer is not in the command prompt[/i][/strike]
[/list]
 

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Now you can restart a level or going back to checkpoint.
[*]A small zoom in control points let you see your friends and world scores much better.
[*]With each new verison we will be adding new features, so, if you have an idea we can bring it to the game. Stay tunned in the community group!
[/list]
 
[h1]KNOWN BUGS![/h1]
The following issues have been already detected by our [b]QA Yabbie department[/b].
[list]
[*][b]issue 079[/b]
We have disabled multi screen support for Mac and linux, de xoElian Devs are working hard to let you switch screens from the game.
[*][b]your issue[/b]
Do you want to be a QA Yabbie? Just send us a message with your bug!. The xoElian Devs love to fix hundred of bugs everyday!. Yep, they are crazy!.
[/list]


Yabbie hugs!!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: xoEl Empire Beta20170531_000
notes.notes:
The great [b]Beta almost Alpha[/b] version, which can be played completely and gives you all the achievements is finally here!.
Our QA Yabbies are not capable to find new bugs! (well, they find some features, but hey! features sometimes are cool). Yayyy!
 
[h1]FIXED BUGS [/h1]
[list]
[*][strike][b]issue 054[/b]
OSX doesn't support the xbox and steam controllers right now, but will do.[/strike]
[*][strike][b]issue 053[/b]
OSX and Intel Graphic cards translate the xoElian spaceship to London, [i](xoElian dev says something about a Flux Capacitator that he can fix)[/i][/strike]
[*][strike][b]issue 046[/b]
Quality settings can’t be changed in the game menu right now.
[/strike]
[*][strike][b]issue 052[/b]
by default the qualitty settings are set to maximum, medium and low presets are being created.[/strike]
[/list]
 
[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Game can be finished now, we hope you enjoy it!!.
[*]The first day of release we will start with the features that stood in the backlog, and with the features asked by our beloved players!. Our plan is to grow this game till the empire owns the whole galaxy!
 
[/list]
 
[h1]KNOWN BUGS![/h1]
The following issues have been already detected by our [b]QA Yabbie department[/b], and will be fixed in the following hours by the [b]xoElian devs[/b].
[list]

In Linux the mouse pointer is hidden somewhere,[i]A xoElian Dev says that he is sure the mouse pointer is not in the command prompt[/i]
[*][b]issue 065[/b]
Some camera clips and oclussion glitches, in places we are not going to tell you...

notes.title: xoEl Empire Beta20170527_000
notes.notes:
Here comes the third [b]Beta[/b] version, we are so close to the final release!

[h1]WARNING[/h1]
If you downloaded the version yesterday, you should reset the player data, it's very easy through the game menu in [b]OPTIONS / GAME / RESET PLAYER DATA[/b]


[h1]FIXED BUGS [/h1]
[list]
[*][strike][b]issue 047[/b]
Doors to other areas of the game are always opened [i](we are considering close permanently doors to final areas to keep some secrets safe)[/i][/strike]
[*][strike][b]issue 048[/b]
Partner yabbies clip out of their boxes [i](due to animation rework, actual animation is kind of placeholder)[/i][/strike]
[*][strike][b]issue 049[/b]
Levels which entry is on the ground can be accessed always, those doors will be closed till the previous level is blocked[/strike]
[*][strike][b]issue 042[/b][/strike]
[*][strike][b]issue 009[/b]
cells that paint player in white are difficult to notice. They can be seen as traps, but should be more noticeable.[/strike]
[/list]

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]We added aditional plots to the game [/b], of course they are spoilers, so we can't say anything here
[*][b]We gave the next step improving performance with memory usage[/b]. The xoElian Dev that make it, was shouting [i]-Give me one more week and I will make this game run in smartwatches! The empire rules!!![/i]
[*]We added a [b]very difficult secret[/b] to the game. QA Yabbies are begging for more clues, and yes, more clues will be included to find the secret!.
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN BUGS![/h1]
The following issues have been already detected by our [b]QA Yabbie department[/b], and will be fixed in the following hours by the [b]xoElian devs[/b].
[list]
[*][b]issue 054[/b]
OSX doesn't support the xbox and steam controllers right now, but will do.
[*][b]issue 053[/b]
OSX and Intel Graphic cards translate the xoElian spaceship to London, [i](xoElian dev says something about a Flux Capacitator that he can fix)[/i]
[*][b]issue 046[/b]
Quality settings can’t be changed in the game menu right now.
[*][b]issue 042[/b]
Steam avatars appear flipped by width,[i]()[/i]
[*][b]issue 006 [/b]
Ship corridors need more ambience sounds.
[*][b]issue 052[/b]
by default the qualitty settings are set to maximum, medium and low presets are being created.
[*][b]issue 050[/b]
in main menu when selecting the max stick sensibility with xbox controllers the player moves continuously
[*][b]issue 051[/b]

notes.title: xoEl Empire Beta 20170520_004
notes.notes:
Here comes the second [b]Beta[/b] version, our Yabbies and xoElians have been working hard.

[h1]FIXED BUGS [/h1]
[list]
[*][strike][b]issue 047[/b]
Doors to other areas of the game are always opened [i](we are considering close permanently doors to final areas to keep some secrets safe)[/i][/strike]
[*][strike][b]issue 048[/b]
Partner yabbies clip out of their boxes [i](due to animation rework, actual animation is kind of placeholder)[/i][/strike]
[*][strike][b]issue 049[/b]
Levels which entry is on the ground can be accessed always, those doors will be closed till the previous level is blocked[/strike]
[/list]

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]The lights are even more amazing[/b]. Yes, one of the xoElian devs takes care of every single detail in relation with lights, shadows, reflections, volumetrics, making the game look much better. You'll enjoy it!.
[*][b]The memory usage has been optimized[/b], so the game now moves even faster.
[*]The QA Yabbies have [b]calibrated levels difficulty[/b], we want the game to be enjoyed by puzzle enthusiasts and platform and exploration lovers!!
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN BUGS![/h1](spoilers inside)
The following issues have been already detected by our [b]QA Yabbie department[/b], and will be fixed in the following hours by the [b]xoElian devs[/b].
[list]
[*][b]issue 054[/b]
OSX doesn't support the xbox and steam controllers right now, but will do.
[*][b]issue 053[/b]
OSX and Intel Graphic cards translate the xoElian spaceship to London, [i](xoElian dev says something about a Flux Capacitator that he can fix)[/i]
[*][b]issue 046[/b]
Quality settings can’t be changed in the game menu right now.
[*][b]issue 042[/b]
Steam avatars appear flipped by width,[i]()[/i]
[*][b]issue 009[/b]
cells that paint player in white are difficult to notice. They can be seen as traps, but should be more noticeable.[i](team members are fighting trying to figure out what can be considered an aestethic trap or an usability bug or a bad practice design, in June we will see who wins)[/i]
[*][b]issue 006 [/b]
Ship corridors need more ambience sounds.
[*][b]issue 052[/b]
by default the qualitty settings are set to maximum, medium and low presets are being created.
[*][b]issue 050[/b]
in main menu when selecting the max stick sensibility with xbox controllers the player moves continuously
[*][b]issue 051[/b]
When you fall with a partner attached, collision with partner can make you float
[*][b]issue 042[/b]
[spoiler]The last level of the game can't be accesed, it can only be accesed doing some stuff and finding other stuff that we want to keep in secret till the release day[/spoiler]
[/list]

Yabbie hugs!!ːsteamhappyː
